item.title: Pakistan's state-backed Christmas celebrations offer rare break from history of extremism
item.description: Government-sponsored Christmas celebrations in Pakistan this year marked a historic departure from the country’s decades-long struggle with religious extremism — where religious minorities, including Christians, have been targeted in bombings, mob attacks and discriminatory practices. #Pakistan #Christmas #Christianpersecution

item.title: Trans-identified TV characters rose slightly in 2025, but most may not return next season: report
item.description: The number of transgender-identified characters on TV is on the rise even as many of the shows on which they appear won't return next season, according to a report from an LGBT media watchdog. #LGBT #Media #GLAAD

item.title: Who were all the Herods in the New Testament?
item.description: When you read the New Testament, you often come across the name Herod. There were different rulers called Herod who formed part of the background history of Jesus and the New Testament. This is the story … #Herod #NewTestament #JohntheBaptist #Jesus #theGospels

item.title: Evangelist's murder sparks widespread grief in Uganda
item.description: Muslim extremists in Uganda killed an evangelist after a public Christian-Muslim dialogue event earlier this month. #Uganda #persecution #Islam #evangelism #Muslimextremists

item.title: Houston Texans coach DeMeco Ryans praises team's belief in Jesus as they clinch playoffs
item.description: Houston Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans gave all glory to God after his team secured a spot in the National Football League playoffs this weekend, praising his players for their faith in Christ. #NationalFootballLeague #HoustonTexans #DeMecoRyans

item.title: Churches should pay for weddings to promote marriage, think tank says
item.description: Amid a declining marriage rate, the Centre for Social Justice, a London-based conservative think tank, has urged the Church of England to remove wedding fees for low-income couples to help make the United Kingdom a “pro-family, pro-marriage nation.” #CentreforSocialJustice #ConservativeThinkTank #ChurchofEngland #WeddingCosts #LowIncomeCouples #Poverty #Equality #ProFamily #ProMarriage

item.title: Washington Post slammed for calling Trump officials' Christ-centered Christmas posts 'sectarian'
item.description: The Washington Post faced criticism for an article and X post last week that described Christmas messages from Trump administration officials as "sectarian" because they mentioned Jesus Christ as Savior. #TheWashingtonPost #DonaldTrump #PeteHegseth #Christmas

item.title: Franklin Graham accuses Dem lawmakers of selling their souls, bashes support for males in women's sports
item.description: Evangelist Franklin Graham has accused Democrats in Washington of selling their souls for power, speaking out against lawmakers who urged the U.S. Supreme Court to allow male trans-identified athletes to participate in sports designated for females. #FranklinGraham #transgender #womenssports #Trump #NCAA

item.title: Okla. pastor recovering from stab wounds after woman wielding dagger attacks church service
item.description: An Oklahoma pastor is recovering from stab wounds after an altercation at his church last week. #Oklahoma #PryorChurchofChrist #Knifeattack

item.title: Pastor, wife spearhead 'inclusive ministry' model for people with disabilities
item.description: California pastor Russ Ewell and his wife, Gail, know firsthand the struggles of finding churches that know how to care for and minister to their children with severe disabilities, a barrier within church and community settings they are now helping congregations break. #megachurch #ministries #disability #specialneeds #church #RussEwell
